problem: There were $9$ chess players who took part in a chess tournament. How many games were played in the tournament if each player faced every other player exactly once?

feedback.worked_solution:
First, note that $(\frac{25}{0})$ means the same thing as ${}_{25}{C}_{0}.$

 In general, the number of combinations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{C}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

Substituting $n=25$ and $r=0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{25}{C}_{0} & =\frac{25!}{(25-0)!0!} \\  & =\frac{25!}{25!0!} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{25!}}{\cancel{25!}\cdot 1} \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
